title: Laf822 drops a limitless battle cry with new single “Harder”
htmlContent: If you’ve been looking for an excuse to follow your heart, Laf822’s new single, “Harder,” featuring 822sweetcandy, has got you covered. This is a burst of pure resolve filtered down to its essence, covered in great production and energy that won’t be denied. “Harder” is a loud reminder that if you want to pursue something, make it challenging. Designed for the grinders, dreamers, and warriors, Laf822 is for the ride to the gym, to get in the zone before a big move, or for that mental reset you need, this track hits the gas and won’t back down. It is a book for people making their way up the chain, which is a message that never gets old. What distinguishes “Harder” is the strength of its lyrics, but that’s not just it. It’s the attitude behind it. There’s an unspoken confidence in every line, a rhythm that feels as if it’s dragging you into something greater. Laf822 clearly has a finger on the pulse of ambition. There’s a rawness here that feels individual and universal, rendering this track a way of life. The beat thumps, the energy remains sky high, and by the time it closes. At a time when distractions are everywhere and motivation can seem like a weakly flashing flame, “Harder” feels like a spark that might inspire a fire under anybody. https://open.spotify.com/track/5BvrFnArKu3t1RSLuVnu3G It’s lean when it comes to fluff and heavy on focus, a trait that, at this point in the artist’s career, sets Laf822 apart as an artist who is clear about what they want to say and how to say it. Whether you’re on the come-up, in the grind, or just that dude who won’t give up and should’ve already, “Harder” is the single that deserves a spot in your rotation. Laf822 is making a statement. And it’s so loud, so clear, so hard to ignore.
